fifty_day.description: Complete 50 tasks in a single day

pomodoro_8.name: Total focus
pomodoro_8.description: Do 8 pomodoros in a single day

rebirth_1.name: Reborn
rebirth_1.description: Be reborn for the first time

hints.midnight: It has to do with the clock.
hints.comeback: Sometimes you disappear for a while.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.hint: Everything you own: what you bought in the shop and what bosses dropped. Tap to equip or remove.
inventory.empty: Your inventory is empty. Buy in the shop or defeat bosses to get items.

gym.toggleHint: Shows the Gym block in the sidebar, with your workouts.

sidebarPrefs.title: Sidebar
sidebarPrefs.hint: The order of the blocks and which ones show. Applies on all your devices.

gymMode.title: Will you use Questlist to work out?
gymMode.body: If you turn it on, the sidebar gets the Gym block, with your workouts, sets and loads and Workout Mode. You can change it later in Profile.

together.title: Who is working out with you now?
together.hint: Whoever you check gets a notice to join. Sets count for the group: anyone can tap on whatever phone is at hand.
together.alone: It's just you here so far. Invite the people you work out with: once they join, they show up in this list and get notified when you start.

group.title: Group training
group.offline: Challenges, wall and chat need a connection.
group.challengeDays: How many days it lasts (1 to 365)
group.daysInvalid: The duration goes from 1 to 365 days.
group.noChallengesHint: In a challenge, whoever works out on the most days by the end wins.
group.rule: Counts as a workout day: completing a workout page or spending 30 min or more in Workout mode.
group.removeMessage: The challenge and the ranking disappear for everyone. Everyone's workout days stay.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.feedIntro: Create a secret link and subscribe to it in your calendar: tasks with a date show up there, and each workout shows up once on its day, with a link to the page.
calendar.feedOffline: Offline: the calendar link can only change with internet.
calendar.feedRotateMessage: The current link stops working. Wherever it was added, you will need to add the new one.
calendar.feedRotated: Link changed. Add the new one to your calendar.
calendar.feedOffMessage: The calendar using this link stops receiving your tasks.
calendar.feedHow: On a computer, in Google Calendar: Other calendars → + → From URL, and paste the link. Google updates it on its own, but a change may take a few hours to show.
calendar.feedPrivate: Anyone with the link can see your task titles. If it leaks, change the link.

camp.label: Camp
camp.missionsDone: No quests open today. Rest, hero.
camp.taunt2: Putting it off again? Good for me.
camp.taunt3: You will never finish that list.
camp.taunt4: Every forgotten task makes me stronger.
camp.tauntLow: No… one more task and I fall!

pets.title: Stable
pets.emptyInventory: Nothing yet. Eggs, potions, food and scrolls drop when you complete tasks in Full mode.
pets.emptyPets: No pets. Combine an egg and a hatching potion to hatch one.
pets.emptyMounts: No mounts. Feed a pet until it grows up.
pets.becameMount: 🐎 {{name}} grew up and became a mount!

quests.title: Quests
quests.hint: Every completed task is a strike on the quest boss. You have {{days}} days.

dragao-do-prazo-perdido.name: Dragon of the Lost Deadline
dragao-do-prazo-perdido.chapter: Atop the broken clock tower, a bronze dragon sleeps on deadlines nobody kept. Every late day gave it a new scale. Wake it with work done.

bruxa-do-pantano.name: Swamp Witch
bruxa-do-pantano.chapter: Lights dance over the swamp, luring travelers off the road. The witch stirs a cauldron of distractions. Keep going, one task at a time, and the spell breaks.

cavaleiro-sem-fim.name: The Endless Knight
cavaleiro-sem-fim.chapter: He has no face, just armor that stretches into shadow: the project that never ends. He only falls when the last step is delivered.

aranha-das-mensagens.name: Spider of Messages
aranha-das-mensagens.chapter: In the crypt of the post, a spider weaves its web from sealed letters. The longer you put off replying, the more threads it gains.

rei-esqueleto.name: Skeleton King
rei-esqueleto.chapter: The king of procrastination rules a kingdom in ruins with a rusted scepter of "I'll see later". His reign ends when you act.

golem-de-ferro.name: Iron Golem
golem-de-ferro.chapter: In the abandoned forge, a golem marches in circles, never leaving its place. A stalled routine feeds it; a kept routine melts it.

game.deadBody: Health reached zero. Buy a life for {{price}} gold and keep everything, or start over at level 1 with nothing (level, XP, gold, items, attributes and pets).
game.restartConfirm: Start over? You lose level, XP, gold, items, attributes and pets. Achievements stay.
game.restarted: A new journey begins at level 1.
game.noGold: You have {{gold}} gold: not enough to buy a life.
game.dayStartHint: These dailies were left unchecked. Check the ones you did and just forgot to record: they won't cost health. The others will.
game.dayStartResting: You are resting at the tavern: nothing costs health today.
game.perfect: ✨ Perfect day! +{{buff}} to all attributes today.
game.tavernHint: For travel, illness or time off: dailies don't cost health while you rest. Boss damage pauses too.
game.tavernOn: You are resting at the tavern.
game.stealth: Stealth: {{count}} daily(ies) protected at the next day start
game.shield: Shield: the next day start costs only half
game.manaHint: Mana refills with every completed task and at the start of the day.

effects.shield: the next day start costs only half the health
effects.stealth: avoids {{power}} missed daily(ies) at the next day start

game.costumeHint: Battle gear gives attributes (by rarity); the costume only changes the look.
game.vocabHint: Tasks become quests, recurring ones become dailies.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.hint: Real-life treats, paid with in-game gold. Create your own.
rewards.name: What is it (e.g. one episode of a show)
rewards.armoireHint: A shop item you don't have yet, for {{price}} gold. If you have them all, you get pet food.

rebirth.title: Rebirth
rebirth.hint: From level {{level}} you can be reborn: your level goes back to 1 and the daily and weekly bosses go back to the starting difficulty, but you keep your gold, items, pets, achievements and attributes, and get +5% XP forever (now it would be +{{bonus}}%, up to +{{max}}%).
rebirth.confirmMessage: You leave level {{level}} and go back to level 1, with +{{bonus}}% XP from now on. To confirm, type "{{word}}".

landing.title: Task, habit and project management with a layer of gamification.
landing.subtitle: Fast as a notebook: jot things down in seconds, organize them in folders and projects, share with the people doing them and, if you like, earn XP and beat bosses along the way.

captura.title: Quick capture
captura.text: Write it the way you say it: "Call the bank tomorrow 3pm !!" becomes a task with date, time, reminder and priority. Paste a list and it becomes many at once.
captura.shot: Today screen with tasks and the capture field

arvore.title: Lists, subtasks and dependencies
arvore.text: Break a project into levels, mark what depends on what and see what you can do right now. Keyboard for everything on a computer.

projetos.title: Folders, projects and teams
projetos.text: Share a project with the people doing it: roles, link invites, @mentions, comments, attachments and each person's progress.
projetos.shot: Folders screen with list and card pages

jogo.title: A game, if you want one
jogo.text: XP, level and class, daily and weekly bosses, clan, achievements, pets and quests. Choose between off, light and full.

treino.title: Habits, workouts and focus
treino.text: Habits with streaks, sets with timed rest, Workout Mode for the gym and pomodoro with time tracking.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: Everything stays on the device and syncs when the connection comes back. On phone and web, in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

legal.acceptBefore: I am {{age}} or older and accept the
legal.acceptLabel: I am {{age}} or older and accept the Terms of use and the Privacy policy
legal.acceptNeeded: To create the account, confirm you meet the minimum age and accept the terms.
legal.gateText: To continue, read and accept Questlist's Terms of use and Privacy policy. They explain what we store, why, with whom and what your rights are.

dataRequest.hint: Need something about your data that isn't here (correct it, know whom we share it with, delete something specific)? Make a request: we answer within 15 days.
dataRequest.messageHint: The request is recorded here and answered within 15 days.
dataRequest.sent: Request sent. The answer shows up here in the Profile.

expenses.badAmount: Type a description and an amount (e.g. 12.50).
expenses.budgetHint: Total the project can spend (empty removes the budget).
expenses.emptyHint: Add one above or take a photo of the receipt.

photo.duplicate: This receipt was already added: "{{description}}" on {{date}}. If you save, it goes in again without the key.
photo.perItemHint_one: {{count}} item read, each one becomes a row
photo.perItemHint_other: {{count}} items read, each one becomes a row
photo.reviewHint: Read from the photo: fix anything wrong before saving.
photo.saved_one: Entry saved with the receipt photo.
photo.saved_other: {{count}} entries saved with the receipt photo.
photo.unreadable: Couldn't read this photo well. Fill in what's missing.
photo.offline: Offline: the photo needs a connection to be read. Add it by hand for now.
photo.not_configured: Photo reading isn't turned on on the server yet.
photo.limit: You've read {{limit}} photos this month. Add entries by hand until next month.
photo.busy: The photo reader is busy. Try again in a minute.
photo.failed: Couldn't read the photo. Try again or add it by hand.
photo.oldDate: The date read is {{date}}, more than 2 months ago. Check the year before saving.
photo.savedOtherMonth_one: Entry from {{date}} saved. It's outside this month, so the list now shows All.
photo.savedOtherMonth_other: {{count}} entries from {{date}} saved. They're outside this month, so the list now shows All.

listPhoto.empty: No items found in this photo.
listPhoto.read_one: {{count}} item read from the photo: check before creating.
listPhoto.read_other: {{count}} items read from the photo: check before creating.
listPhoto.offline: Offline: the photo needs a connection to be read.
